onboarding.title: Welcome to Bodhiva
onboarding.subtitle: Which language are you most comfortable with?
onboarding.description: Healthcare information belongs to everyone. Choose your preferred language to read explanations, charts, and test definitions naturally.
onboarding.changeLater: You can change your language anytime from the top navigation.

hero.badge: Made for patients & families across India
hero.title: Medical reports explained in words you actually understand.
hero.subtitle: Snap a photo of your printed lab test or upload a PDF. Bodhiva explains what each test measures, what your numbers mean, and what to ask your doctor — in your native language.
hero.securityNote: Strictly confidential. No signup required. Instant guest analysis.

features.title: Designed for clarity, empathy, and accuracy
features.subtitle: Healthcare terminology shouldn't feel like a foreign language.

camera.title: Direct Mobile Camera
camera.desc: Take a photo of any printed lab sheet. Our smart viewfinder checks lighting and sharpness before processing.

multilingual.title: True Native Languages
multilingual.desc: Natural explanations in Malayalam, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and English — not clunky word-by-word machine translations.

ranges.title: Visual Reference Ranges
ranges.desc: See exactly where your values fall: within range, higher, or lower, using clean visual range bars and status cards.

doctorPrep.title: Questions for Your Doctor
doctorPrep.desc: Get 3 to 5 clear, sensible questions to ask during your consultation so you never leave the clinic confused.

safety.title: Zero Medical Hallucination
safety.desc: We never invent missing values. If a number or unit is illegible, we explicitly notify you.

privacy.title: Private & Ephemeral
privacy.desc: Guest reports are processed securely and deleted automatically. You can erase all data with a single tap.

sample.title: How a Complete Blood Count (CBC) looks in Bodhiva
sample.explanation: Hemoglobin is the essential protein in red blood cells that carries oxygen from your lungs to the rest of your body. When it is below the reference range, your tissues may receive less oxygen, which can cause tiredness or fatigue.
sample.question: What might be causing this lower level, and do I need iron supplements or dietary changes?

upload.title: Understand Your Medical Report
